description: Use this when the user wants to order one of the offers from get_quotes. Returns that offer (process, quantity, ship-from country, lead time, whether the shop's answer was firm or budgetary) and the terms for ordering through Maglev. Reads the saved quote only: contacts no shop, places nothing, charges nothing. Requires a Maglev API key.

quote_id.description: quote_id of one offer returned by get_quotes
